scheme_name: Educational Assistance for Medical and Engineering Courses
other_conditions: The child's parent or guardian must be registered with the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The student must be enrolled in a government‑recognized medical or engineering institution
A maximum of two children or the wife of the registered worker may apply
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 for medical degrees and ₹60,000 for engineering degrees to eligible children or spouses of registered construction workers.
